title: calendula stipitata
intro: Calendula stipitata, commonly known as Red Maire, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is native to New Zealand and has been used for centuries by the indigenous Māori people for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Red Maire include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which may aid in wound healing, skin conditions, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Red Maire include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
